text.en: Most pet owners praise the veterinary team in Clondalkin, highlighting vet Catriona and the veterinary nurses for their knowledgeable and friendly assistance. Clients appreciate that staff answer questions patiently and follow up by telephone after procedures. While one reviewer experienced dismissive communication following dental surgery, most families describe an attentive and supportive clinic team.

Several reviewers note that their dogs and cats are handled with genuine affection and patience, which helps ease anxiety for nervous pets during clinic examinations and surgeries. However, one cat owner reported significant distress and poor cleanliness following an inpatient dental procedure, whereas other owners describe dogs who happily enter the clinic knowing the nurses will take good care of them.

Pet owners report excellent outcomes for laparoscopic spays, cat neutering, and diagnostic biopsies, noting clear recovery instructions and prompt updates when procedures conclude. In contrast, one reviewer was dissatisfied with recovery complications and post-operative monitoring after a tooth extraction, though others recommend the surgery for reliable surgical care and thorough follow-up.

q.en: Does Village Vets Clondalkin perform laparoscopic spay surgery?

a.en: Yes, clients specifically report successful laparoscopic spays for dogs with clear pre- and post-operative guidance from the surgical team.

q.en: Can consultations and surgeries be scheduled flexibly?

a.en: Reviewers note that the practice accommodates busy schedules well for elective procedures like neutering, though booking in advance is standard.

q.en: How does the clinic follow up after surgical procedures?

a.en: Pet owners report receiving prompt phone calls following surgery to share recovery status and detailed instructions before pet collection.

q.en: Is parking available for visitors at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, clients visiting the Clondalkin surgery can utilise dedicated on-site parking spaces outside the practice entrance.
